_note: Appliance brands mined from Part_Desc text of the 84 APPDE co-op rows (Phase 3 Step 1). The APPDE rows have Part_Manuf = 'Appliance Dealers Cooperative (APPDE)' which is a buying co-op code, NOT a searchable brand. The real brand is embedded in Part_Desc (e.g. 'PDT715SYVFS Ge Dishwasher SS' -> GE). Synonym keys are case-insensitive. Short codes (ge/lg/sq) are matched word-bounded to avoid false hits inside part numbers.
unverified_extras_note: None. Every synonym above was observed in at least one of the 84 APPDE Part_Desc values.

traceability.rows_without_note: 20 rows have no brand token in Part_Desc (e.g. 'PDSH4816AF Dishwasher SS - Display Only'). These fall through to Part_Manuf (APPDE) and rely on part-number-only search.
